name: feed
title: Feed
summary: People post text, photos, videos, documents and links to a shared feed, comment and reply, react, mention each other, and see staff announcements pinned on top.

env.name: FEED_COMMENT_MAX_CHARS
env.doc: Longest comment or reply accepted, in characters.

env.name: FEED_MEDIA_MAX_MB
env.doc: Largest photo or video one post can attach, in MB (upload purpose feed_media).

env.name: FEED_FILE_MAX_MB
env.doc: Largest document one post can attach, in MB (upload purpose feed_file).

stitch: Decide who reads and posts where. Default: one feed (audience "all") for every signed-in person. For org feeds implement feed.Scope (audience keys "org:<id>") and register it with feed.SetScope from an init in internal/api; implement feed.PeopleSearcher so mention suggestions stay inside the org, and subscribe clients with feedAudienceTopic.
Decide who may post announcements. Default: staff (support and admin), from the admin page (Admin → Feed) or the API.
Make feed_media/ and feed_file/ public-read in the bucket policy (keys are unguessable; everything else stays private).
Mobile: expo-document-picker is a native module; rebuild the dev client after installing.
Add the feed to the privacy policy and store data-safety forms: posts, photos, videos and documents people share; post text appears in push notifications.
